meta_description:
lakshmisharath on August 2, 2026: "Flower Therapy ! 

At KR Flower Market, every bloom has a destination. A temple. A wedding. A festival. A home. What begins here quietly becomes part of countless celebrations across the city.

Come early, breathe in the fragrance of fresh jasmine and marigolds, watch the garland makers at work, and lose yourself in one of Bengaluru’s most colourful morning rituals.

There’s something magical about places that come alive before sunrise. And the best way to experience a city is simply to wander.

#KRFlowerMarket #Bengaluru #BangaloreDiaries #FlowerMarket".
